p: It is stated in the Gemara
for the number of ten pesukim
that are said in Malchuyos, Zichronos and Shofaros:
one said, corresponding to the ten utterances
with which the world was created;
another said, corresponding to the Ten Commandments;
and another said, corresponding to the ten praises of Halleluyah
שֶׁמַּר אָמַר חֲדָא וּמַר אָמַר חֲדָא
that one master said one thing and another master said another,
for these three who stated opinions
were referring to the three numbers,
שֶׁל מַלְכֻיּוֹת וְשֶׁל זִכְרוֹנוֹת וְשֶׁל שׁוֹפָרוֹת,
of Malchuyos, of Zichronos and of Shofaros,
וְכָל אֶחָד מְרַמֵּז עַל עִנְיָן אֶחָד.
and each one alludes to one matter.
That is: the one who said
אָמַר הַטַּעַם עַל עֲשָׂרָה פְּסוּקֵי מַלְכֻיּוֹת,
gave the reason for the ten pesukim of Malchuyos,
כִּי זֶהוּ תַּכְלִית הַמְּכוּוָּן שֶׁל הַבְּרִיאָה,
for this is the intended purpose of Creation:
that through it there be revealed
the glory of His kingship, blessed be His Name,
by means of the ten utterances,
"On the sixth day they would say
And the one who said "corresponding to the Ten Commandments"
אָמַר הַטַּעַם עַל עֲשָׂרָה פְּסוּקֵי זִכְרוֹנוֹת,
gave the reason for the ten pesukim of Zichronos,
for they said in the Gemara
"So that your remembrance may rise before Me for good";
the merit of Yisrael will be remembered,
which is the merit of receiving the Torah,
when they received the Ten Commandments,
through which there was fixed in their hearts
the holiness of the ten sefiros,
with the ten utterances of the work of Creation,
corresponds to the aspect of Kesser Elyon,
which is "the intellect hidden from all thought,"
and it corresponds to the utterance "Bereishis,"
וְעִם כָּל זֶה לֹא נֶאֱמַר בּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר,
and nevertheless "And He said" is not stated in it,
the Commandment "I am," etc., in the form of a command,
because regarding the matter of emunah
since this is not in a person's hands
הַשָּׁגוֹת עַל סֵפֶר הַמִּצְוֹת לָרַמְבַּ״ם, מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה א),
in his glosses on the Rambam's Sefer HaMitzvos, Positive Commandment 1);
רַק שֶׁעַל יְדֵי מַאֲמַר הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
rather, through the utterance of Hashem Yisbarach,
by this emunah shone forth in them
from the root, from the Hidden Intellect,
into the collective souls of Yisrael.
all of the Ten Commandments are stated,
up to the last, which is "You shall not covet";
and the desire in the heart
is likewise not in a person's power
but once there had already been absorbed
which are the whole of the words of Torah,
there was nullified from the heart of itself
every kind of desire for this world;
and the Commandment "You shall not covet"
is also an expression of promise:
that you will no longer have
any desire in the heart from now on.
"corresponding to the ten praises in Tehillim" —
for the ten pesukim of Shofaros.
is not an expression of prayer,
with which we praise Hashem Yisbarach
and His mercy upon all His works.
For the essence of the blowing of the shofar
is an allusion to the awakening
of the great shofar of the future,
through which will come the ultimate rectification:
to gather in the dispersed and the lost
And our own mitzvah of blowing the shofar
הוּא רַק לְהִתְעוֹרֵר עַל יְדֵי זֶה
something of the aspect of the great shofar from Above,
which is an arousal from Above
And for this comes the number
for we praise His blessed Name
עַל זֶה שֶׁהַכֹּל הוּא מִכּוֹחוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ
for this: that everything comes from His blessed power,
toward the awakening of the source and root
Therefore, in the three pesukim from the Torah
of the Giving of the Torah,
which were likewise from Him, blessed be He,
וַיְהִי קוֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר הוֹלֵךְ וְחָזֵק מְאוֹד,
"The sound of the shofar grew ever stronger,"
for at that time there truly was
like that of the time to come,
"I said, you are godly beings," etc.;
only afterward it returned, as is known.
Likewise, the pesukim of Shofaros from the Nevi'im
all speak of the shofar blasts
And in the middle are the pesukim of Shofaros
they speak of our own mitzvah of shofar,
and they are from Sefer Tehillim,
to hint that even in the deed that we perform
we know that it is not in our power
rather, we praise His blessed Name
that through an action of ours
we are included so as to reach
the aspect of the awakening of the great shofar,
